risk_summary: The excerpt combines substantial quantified disclosure on receivables, tax valuation allowances, goodwill testing, revenues, and margins with extensive boilerplate forward-looking risk disclaimers. Key risks include customer credit deterioration, tax asset realization, goodwill impairment, litigation, regulatory changes, staffing demand, and operational disruptions, although the reported operating trends and lack of required goodwill impairment are moderately favorable.
